facts.fact: More than Rs 4.47 lakh crore has been transferred to farmers' bank accounts through 23 instalments
facts.quote: More than Rs.4.47 lakh crore has been transferred directly into farmers’ bank accounts through 23 instalments under the Scheme.
facts.note: PIB, 31 Jul 2026. pib.gov.in searches on 28 Oct 2026 found no 24th instalment yet.

facts.quote: The PM-KISAN Scheme was launched in February 2019.

summary: PIB 31 Jul 2026 still the latest total: over Rs 4.47 lakh crore through 23 instalments since Feb 2019; no 24th instalment found.
